WelcomeBody: Play audio on the source, select a listener, then start sharing.
NoOutputs: Connect another playback device in Windows. It will appear here.
TimingNote: The estimate covers software queues. Use a sharp sound to adjust extra delay on the listener you hear first. Measuring Bluetooth and speaker latency requires an acoustic test.
CloseTray: Keep sharing in the notification area when I close the window
TrayHelp: Use the WaveTandem icon in the Windows notification area to reopen the window, stop sharing or exit.
AboutBody: WaveTandem shares the Windows playback mix from one output to other devices. Audio stays on this PC. On supported Windows 11 hardware, Windows Shared Audio is also available through Bluetooth LE Audio.
License: Open source under the MIT License. See LICENSE in the distribution.
OpenSettingsError: Open Settings → System → Sound to manage playback devices.
